ai_disclosure: All images in this collection are created using generative AI tools. Each asset is clearly labeled as AI-generated in metadata and submission tags per Adobe Stock and Shutterstock contributor policies. Images are submitted under the 'AI-generated' content category where required by the platform.

batch_upload_metadata.submission_cadence: 4-5 images per platform per day to avoid review bottlenecks
batch_upload_metadata.title_uniqueness: Write unique titles and descriptions for each platform; do not duplicate across Adobe Stock and Shutterstock
batch_upload_metadata.keyword_ordering: Place 'AI-generated' as the first keyword tag on every submission

pricing_strategy.notes: People-inclusive images and dashboard/UI visuals command higher prices due to complexity and commercial demand. Adjust pricing based on platform-specific performance data after initial 30-day sales period.

quality_checklist_per_asset: Verify no brand logos or identifiable trademarks in the image
Confirm no readable text that could be interpreted as real data
Check hands and fingers for anatomical correctness if people are present
Ensure architectural elements have correct perspective and proportions
Validate minimum resolution of 4000px on the longest side
Tag with AI-generated metadata before submission
Review for common AI artifacts: extra fingers, floating objects, distorted text
Confirm city skylines and buildings are generic and not identifiable real locations
